title: Dragon FC Fall to Blackstone at Gandini
summary: An off-colour Dragon FC were beaten on home soil by Blackstone, with the defeat coming days before Sunday's Chironda Super Cup quarter-final
content:
Dragon FC suffered a disappointing defeat to Blackstone at the Gandini Primary School pitch yesterday, in a performance well below the side's usual standards.

The damage was done early, with a mix-up between the fullback and goalkeeper opening the door for Blackstone's first goal. It was a sign of things to come — for large spells of the match, Dragon FC's midfield was nowhere to be found, leaving the back line exposed and the team unable to build any rhythm going forward. The game ended in a 2 nill defeat to Dragon FC.

Coaching staff will have plenty to work on this week. Dragon FC now turn their attention to Sunday, when they take on a quarter-final tie in the Chironda Super Cup — a chance to put Saturday's result behind them and show the character this club is known for.
author: Dragon FC Media
